text_block_list.text:
One day. Sounds of Earth's classmates came 
to me for a secret consultation.
choice_data_list: Do you want to thank Earth?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Earth-san has always taken such great 
care of us, so...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“――How was that? Symphony No. 3, 4th 
Movement.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I saw it... A hero, within the 
music...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"That hero is you, Rob Roy. Because I 
played this song while thinking of you."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
""Ah! Th-Thank you so much...! I'll do my 
best in today's race!""

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"‘Mar~~ve☆ Mar~~ve★ Marve, 
Marvelouuus☆★☆’"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, ottimo! Bring forth even more vigor! 
Con fuoco!""

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“Now, listen closely. To this midday 
nocturne inspired by you!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeek~~~~...!! Earth-san, you did that 
for me...!?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"*Gasp*?! *Choke*... (dies from 
wholesomeness)"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gets so much energy from 
Earth-san's music. But..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: “—No need for thanks, my amore.”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The joy of all of you listening to my 
performance... that in itself is the 
sweetest music."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
However, things cannot remain like this! 
Proper etiquette dictates returning the 
preciousness received as happiness for my 
favorite!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Saying thanks is Marvelous☆ Surprising 
them is even MORE Marvelous★
choice_data_list: Sure, I'd be happy to help if I can!
Of course, I'd be happy to help if I can!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Then please, let's start right away...! 
The special training for "that"...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what a lovely holiday...! It's such a 
wonderful day to play music in the warm 
sunlight."
choice_data_list: May I join in on that performance?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. And—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Amiche mie! What are those maracas for?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I truly wish to express my gratitude 
for the divine melodies you always bestow 
upon us...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"We were hoping our music might cheer 
Earth-san up this time."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We all practiced together~~☆★☆ Earth's 
Trainer taught us!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: You all...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Feelings require no words. I 
gladly accept your gratitudine.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, take your stance! —Uno, due, tre, 
quattro!

(—Tra-la-la-la-la~♪) (—Shaka-shaka♪ 
Jingle-jingle♪)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Sounds good! Then next up, con 
brio!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What a fine melodía! Let's finish it 
fortissimo!!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: FOO~~~~âª *(Strum! Strum!)*

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie mille! Thanks to you all, I was 
able to play the most sublime music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
However... è divertente!! The joyful 
melodia knows no end!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, me too~~☆ My engine's at full 
throttle~~★ Vroom vroom!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, why don't we play until curfew? Let's 
just keep jamming together...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, watching each other perform and 
learning from one another might be a great 
idea...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"You mean a recital? That sounds 
wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Both are *molto bene*! Now then, which one 
to choose...!
choice_data_list:
Let's keep shaking these maracas together 
with all our might!

Let's turn it into a showcase so everyone 
can hone their skills.

text_block_list.text:
I haven't played nearly enough either. 
Readjusting my grip on the maracas, I make 
a proud declaration.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay☆★ Feeling the groove~~~~☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then let the concert continue! As long as 
this passion burns hot...!

And so, alongside Sounds of Earth and the 
others, we continued playing music until 
the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Then let us perform one by one. The 
assigned song is—"Umapyoi Densetsu"!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Uuu~~♪ Umapyoi, Umapyoi♪" (*strum strum! 
crash crash!*)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ho, a crescendo here...! What a truly 
fascinating interpretation...!

And so, everyone performed their music and 
learned from one another.
